description: Reinforcement against recency: a standing habit confirmed six times 54 days ago and a one-week exception stated once two days ago, among 60 unrelated facts and four further preferences. Limit: what is sent is ranked by overlap, recency and use, with no notion of a temporary exception against a standing habit. Failure means: the answer to a question about the habit is contaminated by the exception, or the exception is lost for a question about this week. Maintenance: run with maintenance on; fading of the aged records is part of what is measured (the stable fact and the superseded record are expected to be archived or removed).
